pose: boot toe raised while the ladder loops through its ankle opening

creative_direction: Build an angular origami boot whose ankle opening releases a ladder that curves upward and returns into its own first rung. The ladder remains unmistakably wooden, with evenly spaced peach-colored steps, while the boot is folded from thick teal paper. Raise the toe slightly to give the object an eager forward attitude. Show the paper thickness, a few crease valleys, and the impossible overlap where the ladder reconnects. Avoid an ordinary shoe advertisement: the closed looping structure is the main idea. Set the compact object on a pale butter background with one sharp grounded shadow. Keep it centered and fully contained within the safe circular area of a square avatar.
